g.text: Firmware slot loop and the telemetry trigger
every 8.994 ms; a trigger every 12 slots or more (after the last capture is out and acked)
ESP32 firmware, every slot (run_hop in d8tone.c)
trigger slot k: listen instead of sending k+1
no: byte 3 = 0, byte 4 = k; yes: byte 3 = 2, byte 4 = tid
6.70 ms of 2-FSK; on a trigger slot, go to the trigger row below
16 MS/s ring capture, starts ~0.2–0.4 ms after the last bit
skip 1 ms, int4; no reply energy: "EV tlm_drop" and one retry, same tid
